nodes.label: JWT Secrets (ACCESS/REFRESH)
nodes.rationale: JWT secrets should be at least 32 characters in production for security.

nodes.label: Dual Architecture in Migration
nodes.rationale: Frontend has parallel legacy/current implementations (axios apiService vs shared apiClient, component router vs createBrowserRouter) indicating incomplete migration.

nodes.label: FastAPI Service Connection Bypass
nodes.rationale: Frontend KYC code calls FastAPI directly at http://localhost:8000, bypassing the main API gateway and auth middleware; no documented proxy endpoint in Node backend.

nodes.label: Multi-Step KYC Flow
nodes.rationale: Frontend KYC 5-step wizard calls both Node backend (document CRUD) and FastAPI (OCR + face verification), bridging both services in submit flow.

nodes.label: Separated Services Architecture
nodes.rationale: Project refactored into two-service microservices architecture: backend-node (Express API Gateway, port 4000) and backend-fastapi (Python ML service, port 8000), sharing one PostgreSQL instance.

nodes.label: KYC Document Upload Request Flow
nodes.rationale: Frontend posts multipart to backend-node which proxies to backend-fastapi for OCR/face processing; results stored in PostgreSQL, response returned to client.

nodes.label: User Avatar Lifecycle Management
nodes.rationale: Avatar upload rules belong in a dedicated upload middleware instead of controller code; stale files removed on replace/delete; audited via UPDATE_AVATAR/DELETE_AVATAR.

nodes.label: Middleware Stack Pattern
nodes.rationale: Standard middleware order authenticate → authorize(roles) → validate(schema) → controller ensures auth, RBAC, and validation before business logic.

nodes.label: Audit Service (fire-and-forget)
nodes.rationale: Fire-and-forget pattern: never throws, always wraps in try/catch so audit logging failures don't break user operations.

nodes.label: Token Refresh & Rotation
nodes.rationale: Rotation-based refresh tokens is a security best practice to limit token exposure; old session revoked, new session created.

nodes.label: Document Management System
nodes.rationale: Files always moved to archive on soft-delete (never hard-deleted); user IDs in filenames enable quick ownership verification; relative paths stored for portability.

nodes.label: KYC Module (FinGuard)
nodes.rationale: KYC provides comprehensive identity verification pipeline supporting mixed-script (Devanagari + English) document processing; decoupled into backend (FastAPI+SQLAlchemy) and frontend (React+TypeScript) layers.

nodes.label: OCR Service (PaddleOCR + fuzzy matching)
nodes.rationale: PaddleOCR with lang=['hi','en'] for mixed-script; images resized to max 1080px and CLAHE contrast enhancement for improved OCR accuracy on i3 processor.

nodes.label: Identity Verification Service (DeepFace)
nodes.rationale: DeepFace VGG-Face model (64-D embedding) with OpenCV detector; Euclidean distance threshold 0.4 for match; threshold tuned for VGG-Face model.

nodes.label: Mixed-Script Support (Devanagari + English)
nodes.rationale: Fuzzy matching handles variations, typos, and mixed formatting (e.g., 'नाम:', 'नाम :', 'NAAMAAAA'); Unicode ranges used for language detection.

nodes.label: Frontend Redux State Model
nodes.rationale: Redux store given canonical entrypoint (store.ts) so hooks and app providers import one source of truth; auth slice now owns tokens, loading/error, client details.

nodes.label: Centralized Theme System
nodes.rationale: Theme application centralized (applyThemeToDocument) so class, CSS variables, body colors, and persisted state move together; theme state persists across reloads.

nodes.label: Router as Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: Router now source of truth for authenticated pages, role guards, placeholders, and login/register redirects; /auth is compatibility redirect to /login.

nodes.label: Route Guard Hierarchy (ProtectedRoute/RoleProtectedRoute)
nodes.rationale: ProtectedRoute checks isAuthenticated from Redux, fetches /users/me if userData missing; RoleProtectedRoute checks user role against requiredRoles.

nodes.label: FinGuard Frontend OCR & Face UI
nodes.rationale: Frontend KYC integration uses reusable UI components; useKYC hook encapsulates API calls and TanStack Query state; react-hook-form + zod for step-1 validation.
